description: Convert an image to another format (png, jpg, webp, gif, avif, bmp, tiff) and write it to the output path.

format.description: Target image format: one of png, jpg, webp, gif, avif, bmp, or tiff.

input.description: Path to the source image file to convert.

output.description: Path where the converted image will be written. Its extension is replaced by the target format when they differ.

name: convert_image
